response.original_title: [Add-Passenger] How do I add a Passenger to my Sea Cloud  Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to your Sea Cloud Cruises booking, you must contact Sea Cloud Cruises customer service directly +1-866-254-7549 or reach out to your personal travel agent +1-866-254-7549, as this process cannot be completed online +1-866-254-7549 or through an app. Steps to Add a Passenger Review Your Existing Booking: Check your current stateroom category to see if it can legally accommodate an extra person +1-866-254-7549  (e.g., standard double vs. triple/quad configurations). Call Sea Cloud Cruises or Your Travel Advisor: You can contact their customer relations team by phone +1-866-254-7549  to manually process the update. Confirm Changes and Fees: The representative will recalculate your reservation +1-866-254-7549. Be aware that adding a guest will trigger a re-price of the cabin at the current prevailing fare, and you will be responsible for additional cruise fares, taxes, and port fees.
